text:
Picture a builder in Midland. Latest post on his website's blog: photos from the 2024 staff Christmas party.

Nobody searches Google for that.

They search "how long does a bathroom reno take?"

Answer that question on your website. That blog post brings in work.

Quick one. Which email gets Google's alerts about your Business Profile?

If it's the web designer you stopped using in 2021, nobody is reading them.

Google sends those alerts when someone suggests a change to your listing.

Send them to an inbox you check every day.

I am so old that I remember when the whole marketing plan was an ad in the Yellow Pages.

Be in the book. Answer the phone.

Now people look on Google instead of the book.

Same plan. Be on Google. Answer the phone.
